_comment: Verbatim copies of the two files stage_on_pass_review reads for stage_analog — the INTENT (L5_ADI_SPEC.json) and the ARTEFACT (phase3/analog/<block>/spec.json) — from real runs on this fleet. Nothing here is authored: each sha256 below is the source file's, and accept_adc_conv and reject_adc_stub share a byte-identical L5, so the control varies the ARTEFACT alone while the intent and the harness are held fixed.

accept_adc_conv.why: a completed run of the incremental delta-sigma ADC front-end: both declared blocks in scope, every numeric requirement the intent declares carried by the spec the stage grades against

reject_adc_stub.why: the SAME design and the byte-identical L5 as accept_adc_conv, with the analog runner's deterministic-stub A1 tier: one row per block, `vout target 1.0 V`, against an intent declaring Vout 1.2 V (1.1-1.3) and twelve further numeric requirements

accept_published_partial.why: the published benchmark cell: one block the intent declares no numeric requirement for (DISARMED by the intent's own disclosure) and one measured and accepted
